title: Auto Location Update
body: Beans Route is making it even easier to ensure accurate deliveries.  We now offer auto-updating for location pins directly from the driver app. To use this feature, follow the steps below:   From the Dispatch Console: 1.  Click Settings > Preferences > Routes.   2.  In the “Driver Controls” section, turn on the option “allow drivers to auto-update location data” and then click “Save” at the bottom of the page.  NOTE: we recommend a geofence of 500 feet to ensure best results.  Once the setting is enabled, if a driver attempts to deliver a stop outside of the geofenced area, they will receive a prompt asking if they wish to update the address location data. If the driver updates the location data, this change will be visible in Custom Geocodes*. NOTE: the prompt to update location data is only visible when the driver tries to mark the delivery as successful. .           *To view Custom Geocodes, from the dispatch console: click Settings > Custom Geocodes.
